name: bnhs-grading-system
description: Senior High School grading system for Balakan National High School (DepEd K to 12). Web + Android.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bnhs/server" "npm run dev -w @bnhs/web"
